lines.en: I beat my big wings and rise
My hat sways in the wind
I drop from the tree to the ground
I make half a circuit before landing

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开像一面旗
lines.en: My wings open like a banner

lines.zh: 我飞得很稳，不像小蝙蝠
lines.en: I fly steady, unlike the small bats
I head behind you

lines.zh: 我停在树干上，收起翅膀
lines.en: I land on the trunk and fold my wings
I raise my head your way
I flap once in your direction
I hang with my hat brim low
My wings wrap around me
I grind my teeth slowly
My claws have scarred the bark

lines.zh: 我把这脑袋一寸寸转过来
lines.en: I turn this head an inch at a time
I'm counting your breaths
The hat is new
I take it very seriously
I shake my wings out
I open my mouth; my teeth are white

lines.zh: 我在等一个称心的东西
lines.en: I wait for something to my liking
I'm very patient; I wait

lines.zh: 这片林子我闭着眼都认
lines.en: I could walk this wood blind
It's quiet under this tree
I slowly let go of the branch
I drop, then hang again

lines.zh: 我看着你，你看着我的帽子
lines.en: I look at you; you look at my hat
It's mine; don't touch
I flex my wings
You shouldn't stand under my tree
Your things are handsome
I'll take all of these
I lower myself inch by inch

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就快一点
lines.en: If you hold still, I'll be quick
I'm choosing what to take first
You've backed off; I'm still looking
My hat is better than yours
I laugh, high and sharp
I retreat to the branch
My hat nearly falls
I cry out, gratingly
I shake out both big wings
I clamp a hand on my hat
I watch you and don't come again
I land on a high branch
My claws grip hard
I haven't taken my eyes off you
I haven't given up
I like this one
Put it in my hands
Your hat is decent too
Let me see the quality
Bright things suit me best
Hold it steady
No hurry; I'll wait for you to let go
You're reluctant to let go
Then something else
I'm having this one

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞进一团羽毛
lines.en: You hit me like a burst of feathers
I fold a wing and wrap you
You struggle out of my wing
We both hit the tree
I shoulder you off with a wing
My hat slides over my eyes
I reach up and straighten it
You've pinned my tail underfoot
I flick it hard
I don't like this coat being touched

lines.zh: 树上还有一只戴着什么
lines.en: Another on the tree wears something too

lines.zh: 它的帽子是一顶旧礼帽
lines.en: Its hat is an old bowler

lines.zh: 我们对看了一下各自的帽子
lines.en: We look at each other's hats
We trade them
It wears mine, I wear its
We hang together
We comb each other's fur
Its wings are even wider than mine
This tree hangs two of us nicely
Tonight we patrol together
I hook it up in my claws
This is good; I'll keep it

lines.zh: 我撩起帽檐，把它塞进去
lines.en: I tip my hat brim and tuck it in
It's too heavy to fly high with
I hide it in a hollow
I count my hoard
Take this back; it's too old
I put it on my head
This one is a little small
But I don't mind
I've got my eye on what you're holding
I drop off the branch

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开，影子盖住你
lines.en: My wings open and my shadow covers you

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，我只是想要
lines.en: I mean no harm; I only want it
It won't help you to back off
I'm much faster than you
I begin fanning the air
This tree is my ground
I take one thing at a time
Give me that
I don't want to hurt you
But I will do it
I don't fly high, but I'm heavy

lines.zh: 我的帽子在风里往后飘
lines.en: My hat streams back in the wind
I circle twice over your head
I open my claws
Your things catch the light
I've begun my descent
I circle above you
You're holding it tighter

lines.zh: 我在上头数着你的脚步
lines.en: I count your steps from up here
You pass beneath and I watch
I beat my wings once
Leaves fall all over you

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我换到另一个枝
lines.en: You raise an arm and I move to another branch
I stay circling at your shoulder
You've started to run
The wood is only so big
I cut through the trees
The wingbeats draw nearer
I glide low over the ground
I don't call; it would alert the others
I'm coming down on your head
You won't get out of this wood
Your grip is loosening
I want that one

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪着，你躲不掉
lines.en: My hat's askew, and you can't hide
Leave the thing behind
I dive, claws first
My wings close over you

lines.zh: 这一下抓在你的手腕上
lines.en: That catches your wrist
You're knocked onto your seat
I bite your cuff
You fling me and I lift off

lines.zh: 这一下我没抓到，落在树上
lines.en: I miss and land on the tree
I hit your back from behind
My hat falls off
I dive at once to catch it
That gave me an opening
Got you that time
You still won't let go
Then I won't be gentle

lines.zh: 树上落下一个大的影子
lines.en: A large shadow drops from the tree

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，慢慢降下来
lines.en: I spread my wings and descend slowly

lines.zh: 我的帽子先出现在树叶间
lines.en: My hat appears among the leaves first
The branch dips under me
These trees are my ground
I hang a while first

lines.zh: 我的翅音比别的蝙蝠重
lines.en: My wingbeat is heavier than the others'
I smell something new
I settle on the branch and watch you

lines.zh: 铃铛没有响，这不是圣诞林
lines.en: No bells; this isn't the Christmas wood

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在地上的落叶上
lines.en: My shadow lands on the leaves first

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的风把叶子吹开
lines.en: My wingbeat pushes the leaves apart

lines.zh: 我从一根粗枝上翻身下来
lines.en: I swing down from a thick branch
I spread my wings and claim the canopy
I set my hat straight
The light under the tree dims

lines.zh: 我不着急，我有很多时间
lines.en: No hurry; I have plenty of time
In the dark, my eyes flash.

lines.zh: 我先看看你身上有什么
lines.en: First let me see what you carry
The wind drops and I'm still in the tree

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我拍着往上飞
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and I beat upward

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，撞在树根上
lines.en: I fall from high onto the roots
Water holds me down; my wings are heavy
The blast slams me into the tree
An arrow goes through my wing
Magic loosens my claws

lines.zh: 这林子里没有我想要的东西
lines.en: Nothing here is worth having

lines.zh: 雷光把树照亮，我无处躲
lines.en: The flash lights the tree and I can't hide
No tree below; I find nothing
